task.title: first unique item
task.appendix:
Targets: counting-by-hand, membership-branch

Hidden checks (behavior must be preserved):
assert first_unique(["a", "b", "a", "c"]) == "b"
assert first_unique(["a", "a", "b", "b"]) is None
assert first_unique([]) is None
assert first_unique([3, 1, 3, 1, 2]) == 2
assert first_unique(["only"]) == "only"

Idiomatic reference:
from collections import Counter


def first_unique(items):
    counts = Counter(items)
    return next((item for item in items if counts[item] == 1), None)
task.check:
assert first_unique(["a", "b", "a", "c"]) == "b"
assert first_unique(["a", "a", "b", "b"]) is None
assert first_unique([]) is None
assert first_unique([3, 1, 3, 1, 2]) == 2
assert first_unique(["only"]) == "only"
